description: Mounted on a pylon at 22 Wing in 414 Squadron markings. Renumbered 100500 in 1970 and flown by 414 (EW) Squadron at North Bay; Major P. Growen reached 3,000 hours on type flying it on 10 October 1980 and its last flight was on 27 July 1981.
museum_name: Canadian Forces Museum of Aerospace Defence, 22 Wing North Bay

description: Mounted on a pylon at 22 Wing painted all black as EF-101B 101067 of 414 (EW) Squadron. Ex-USAF 57-0420. The real 101067 was a leased USAF aircraft returned in 1987 and is in Minnesota, so the marking is false.
museum_name: Canadian Forces Museum of Aerospace Defence, 22 Wing North Bay
